name: Survive Bikini Bottom
desc:
Bikini Bottom isn’t the place you remember. ☠️

🧭 Explore a twisted Bikini Bottom
🔥 Outsmart Creatures That Hunt You in the Dark
🏚️ Scavenge Abandoned Locations for Gear and Clues
🧩 Piece Together the Mystery One Night at a Time
📍 Discover New Areas as the Chaos Spreads Each Night
🐚 Rescue SpongeBob and Friends Before Bikini Bottom Collapses

📱💻🎮 Play on PC, Mobile, Tablet & Console!
